budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81-CAPRST 10-21 s81sl_capc5r = capc5k recipe (same floorplan/children/hooks/CTS balance) on the successor RTL ot_s81sl_capc5r: capc5c's plain cross-region reset hops (u_lpr_root ck_rt -> u_lpr_cw/ce/rn/rs, single-cycle reg->reg between regional clocks) replaced by five regional reset ports rst_n_<r>, each landed 2 stages on its own region clock beside its pin (lp.py regional_reset_ports + regional_reset_copies); same reset age RB 2, cycles/landings unchanged. Pins: rst_n_rt W beside ck_rt, rst_n_cw W / rst_n_ce E beside their clocks, rst_n_rn N beside ck_rn (cfg_d 4.32-160.0), rst_n_rs S (old rst_n slot). DRIVE-S81-CAP 10-20 s81sl_capc5k = capc5i + post_cts REFINE (rt_leaf_balance.tcl ot_rtb_refine): the 5i/5j gates (GRT0, cw/ce 30-43 in 5j) failed only rt pair TT 86.2/FF 84.5 because DPL + hold repair after the in-CTS balance moved the soft region (512..536 -> 470..497) while the u_rt chain did not follow (u_rt 493..556); refine after repair removes/adds u_rt chain stages to the soft centre, legalises and re-measures (offline replay on the 5i db: pair 86.1 -> 48.7 TT). DRIVE-S81-CAP 10-20 s81sl_capc5k: capc5e (W-face ck_rt entry) + POST-CTS REGION LATENCY BALANCE on ck_rt (rt_leaf_balance.tcl): capc5e per-sink TT showed the rt region tree split into two tight bands (N 382..426, S 444..497 under the 259-um u_rt; u_rt boundary 395..459) -> a ~62 ps systematic branch imbalance, not spread. Every leaf driver and the u_rt clock pin are brought to the latest group centre with whole BUFx4 delay stages (offline replay on the capc5e CTS db: pair 102 -> 50 ps, soft spread 24). capc5g/h (clock_split_km) are dropped: under the hybrid -clk_nets CTS the cluster nets got NO tree (one BUFx24 per ~1300 sinks, 548/624 ps). GRT fix generalised: RSZ-3006 in 5g/5h came from max_wire_repeat's kept strong INV (_2216_ after u_fw.q[66]); pre_grt releases instance dont_touch on every non-clock std cell except out-pin drivers / hold cells (cells/nets unchanged). Same RTL, regions, landings, cycles. S81-TILES-B 10-20 VARIANT E = capc5c with the ck_rt entry moved from the S face (x185) to the W face at y95-97, in the W channel beside u_rt between the two rt register bands (S band y~10-40 under u_rt, N band y~150-200 above it): capc5c/5d gates FAILED ck_rt TT 131/FF 108 pin-flop spread because the S-face entry reached the N band only around the 250-um-wide u_rt. Same RTL (ot_s81sl_capc5c), regions, children, landings. S81-CAPC5 10-20 VARIANT C of the LANDED capc parent (tools/landed_parent/specs/ot_s81sl_capc5c.json from flat ot_s81sl_capc5cf): capc5b gate 03:2x FAILED clock with cw 49/49 PASS but core 134/120 and rt 178/150 (a region holding a hard child or u_rt together with a full face of pin registers gets ~100+ ps TritonCTS soft spread). C = 5 LOCAL regions: rt (u_rt + landing rings only), cw (W face regs + u_ld3 + u_tw, as B PASS), ce (E face regs + u_te + u_ed), rn (N face: cfg in-regs + N out-regs), rs (S face out-regs + fault). Every u_rt output face is now LANDED into its own face region (S +3 vs capc5b: all outputs W+8 = +6 vs capc2; inputs unchanged). rt reset loads 45 -> lp regional_reset_copies (2 kept copies, same reset age, no added edge). n32 ring writer kept (native32).
